sources.entry: Memtly - Event photo sharing platform and gallery with slideshow that allows guests to view and share memories via a QR code. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 C#/Docker

summary.one_liner: Memtly is a self-hostable event photo and video sharing gallery where guests upload their own media via a shared link or QR code, with a slideshow view.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a basic site with one goal: letting hosts and guests share memories leading up to and during an event. The host shares a gallery link, or prints the generated QR code for guests to scan on arrival. Visitors can view the gallery and upload their own images and videos. The README says the project was originally called WeddingShare and renamed because it is used for concerts, trips and other events too. Setup steps and configurable options are in a separate documentation site, not in the README. The README mentions a GALLERY_ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES environment variable for controlling accepted formats. It notes that HEIC images are not supported and won't be accepted as an issue.
use_cases: QR code photo gallery for parties
guest photo uploads for concerts or trips
how_to_run: Setup steps are in the external documentation site linked from the README (not included in the README itself).
A Docker image is linked on DockerHub per the README's links section.
notable: Guests scan a printed QR code to reach the gallery and upload their own photos and videos
Built-in slideshow view of event media
Originally named WeddingShare, renamed to Memtly to cover any kind of event
Configurable accepted file types via GALLERY_ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES
caveats: HEIC images are explicitly not supported; users must convert to JPG, and HEIC-related issues will be closed
README includes a disclaimer that there are no warranties and use is at your own risk
Setup and full configuration details are only in the external documentation site
